final: SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_of_rating_avg_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_rating_avg_ratio FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) AS per_rating
